scene_purpose: Let Torren materially demonstrate why Maevra sought him by guiding the party to Hollow Watch without using the obvious occupied route; establish the fort, Black Host occupation, active excavation, and older exposed construction in one clean reveal; preserve later revelations and the established Cyanis-only wilderness traversal presentation.

scene_context_seed.location_name: Greenhollow north edge → Hollow Watch approach → reveal overlook → fort threshold
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: HARD PRESENTATION: Greenhollow may show the relevant party/NPC field models. Once ordinary wilderness traversal begins, Cyanis is the sole visible party field character; Torren remains the guide through portrait/dialogue speech. Triggered reveal/threshold scenes may spawn the relevant field models in simple positions. Do not author follower-train traversal, route-inspection choreography, track/rut analysis, root/foliage interaction, coat grabs, weapon-ready gestures, fixed-enemy spotting, or other micro-blocking. HARD STORY: one major visual reveal establishes Hollow Watch as a small Yahtrean cliff fort under Black Host occupation with active excavation and older exposed construction. HARD RANDOM ENCOUNTER: ordinary enemies remain random encounters. Torren has not entered the occupied fort and does not know the garrison fate, excavation goal, hidden descent, buried-structure purpose, or later cartographic significance. Cyanis carries the intact Card; it remains inert.

required_story_beats: Leave Greenhollow and take Torren's less obvious approach route.
Use one clean Hollow Watch reveal to establish the fort, occupation, excavation, and older exposed construction.
Torren provides a practical entry plan under the west wall.
Reach the occupied-fort threshold without learning the garrison fate or excavation target.
